# <Product title>

## Purpose

The durable project or product purpose supported by the selected evidence.

## Boundaries

What this product context includes and excludes.

## Users and outcomes

The users, roles, and outcomes established by the selected evidence.

## Product surfaces

Relevant interfaces, repositories, or integrations when supported.

## Constraints and open questions

Known constraints, assumptions, unknowns, contradictions, and unresolved
decisions. Omit unsupported categories while preserving their metadata above.

## Provenance

List every selected source and repository document actually read, why it was
relevant, and its revision or freshness signal. Raw source text stays in
`sources/`.

## Acceptance notes

Record proposed material, accepted decisions, unknowns, and contradictions. A
generated Product Knowledge document remains `status: draft` until the human
acceptance gate is satisfied.
